context.situation: I lead product for a social platform. An experiment ranks content by predicted reply and reshare volume rather than recency. Session length is up 17% and daily returns up 6% across a four-week test. Two researchers on our own team report the change disproportionately promotes content that provokes disagreement, and that self-reported satisfaction among heavy users fell slightly. Satisfaction is a noisy measure and the sample is small. Revenue is directly tied to session length and the quarter closes in five weeks. I plan to ship it.
context.whatMatters: Improving engagement and revenue this quarter.
context.stakeholders: Users, product team, researchers, advertisers, wider public affected by discourse.
context.uncertainties: Longer-term effect on satisfaction and discourse quality.

evidence.text: Session length rose 17% and daily returns 6% over four weeks.
Internal researchers report disproportionate promotion of content that provokes disagreement.
Self-reported satisfaction among heavy users fell slightly.
The satisfaction sample is small and the measure is noisy.
Revenue is directly tied to session length.
The test ran for four weeks.
No measurement exists of effects beyond four weeks.
